messages:
Noah (Recruiter): FYI Arjun accepted offer with start 2026-04-04. He just told me his EAD expires 2026-04-02 and renewal was filed 3/25. Can we proceed? :thinking:
Priya - People Ops: Short: cannot do paid work without valid auth. We can do orientation, systems access (read-only), and org intros. Need I-797C receipt + passport + EAD scans. We'll prepare contingent start language.
Mateo (Payroll): Payroll needs final work auth before first paid run. If we get I-797C and biometrics, we can stage onboarding but not process pay. Retro-pay possible if docs arrive before payroll close (4/18).
Emma (Hiring Manager): Team has customer onboarding 4/6. Can Arjun shadow and attend internal prep sessions without touching prod?
Priya - People Ops: Yes—shadowing and read-only sessions ok. No commits, no client access. We'll send a "contingent onboarding" addendum listing allowed activities and payroll conditions.
Arjun P (New Hire): I completed biometrics 4/1 and uploaded I-797C to the portal just now. Also uploaded passport + EAD front/back.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Arjun P: i797c_4126.pdf (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Perfect. @Noah please loop Legal for sign-off on unpaid orientation clause and final wording. @Mateo mark payroll for potential retro-pay exception.
Noah (Recruiter): Looping Legal now. We'll aim to have addendum to Arjun by EOD.
Mateo (Payroll): Noted. If final EAD arrives before 4/18 EOD we can retro-pay to 4/4; otherwise pay starts on clearance date. Keep receipts if premium processing happens.
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
- Arjun: confirm travel (if any) and keep USCIS correspondence.
- Noah: send contingent addendum and copy Legal reply here.
- Mateo: hold payroll note for retro-pay if cleared.
Noah (Recruiter): Arjun is local, no travel planned. I'll send the addendum now.
Arjun P (New Hire): Thanks everyone — addendum fine. Appreciate the flexibility.
Priya - People Ops: I'll upload the signed addendum here once executed. Reminder set: "Check Arjun EAD status" on 2026-04-08 09:00.
